using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Orleans.Transactions.TestKit;
using Xunit;

namespace Orleans.Transactions.TestKit.UnitTests
{
    public class SingleStateFaultInjectionTransactionalGrainTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task OnActivateAsync_LogsGrainId()
        {
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var mockLoggerFactory = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            var mockData = new Mock<IFaultInjectionTransactionalState<GrainData>>();
            mockLoggerFactory.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(mockLogger.Object);

            var grain = new SingleStateFaultInjectionTransactionalGrain(mockData.Object, mockLoggerFactory.Object);

            // Setup GetGrainId and GetPrimaryKey for the grain
            var grainId = grain.GetGrainId().ToString();
            var primaryKey = grain.GetPrimaryKey();

            await grain.OnActivateAsync(CancellationToken.None);

            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("GrainId")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task Set_LogsSettingValueAndUpdatesData()
        {
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var mockLoggerFactory = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            var mockData = new Mock<IFaultInjectionTransactionalState<GrainData>>();
            mockLoggerFactory.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(mockLogger.Object);

            var grain = new SingleStateFaultInjectionTransactionalGrain(mockData.Object, mockLoggerFactory.Object);

            // Setup PerformUpdate to invoke the action immediately
            mockData.Setup(d => d.PerformUpdate(It.IsAny<System.Action<GrainData>>()))
                .Returns<System.Action<GrainData>>(action =>
                {
                    var data = new GrainData();
                    action(data);
                    return Task.CompletedTask;
                });

            await grain.Set(42);

            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Setting value")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task Add_LogsAddingValueAndUpdatesData()
        {
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var mockLoggerFactory = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            var mockData = new Mock<IFaultInjectionTransactionalState<GrainData>>();
            var faultInjectionControl = new FaultInjectionControl();
            mockLoggerFactory.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(mockLogger.Object);

            var grain = new SingleStateFaultInjectionTransactionalGrain(mockData.Object, mockLoggerFactory.Object);

            // Setup PerformUpdate to invoke the action immediately
            mockData.Setup(d => d.PerformUpdate(It.IsAny<System.Action<GrainData>>()))
                .Returns<System.Action<GrainData>>(action =>
                {
                    var data = new GrainData { Value = 10 };
                    // Setup FaultInjectionControl property on mockData
                    mockData.SetupGet(m => m.FaultInjectionControl).Returns(faultInjectionControl);
                    action(data);
                    return Task.CompletedTask;
                });

            await grain.Add(5, faultInjectionControl);

            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Adding")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}

The error indicates the PerformUpdate method is generic and requires explicit type arguments. I will fix the test by specifying the type argument for PerformUpdate calls and adjust the mock setup accordingly. Also, I will mock the FaultInjectionControl property properly for the Add method test. I will resubmit the corrected test file now.

The PerformUpdate method is generic and requires a Func<GrainData, TResult> argument, but the code calls it with an Action<GrainData>. This means the method is overloaded or has a different signature than assumed. I will adjust the test to mock PerformUpdate with the correct signature using a Func and specifying the TResult type explicitly. I will also mock PerformRead for the Get method to complete coverage.
